name: Official Listening Party: Iommi "From The Dark" + Høstsabbat Pre-Party - DJs, Merch, Lottery & Ticket Exchange
description:
Official Listening Party: Iommi "From The Dark"
+ Høstsabbat Pre-Party - DJs, Merch, Lottery & Ticket Exchange
Vaterland
Thursday 22. October - 17:00
FREE // GRATIS // NADA
----------------------------
----------------------------
Vaterland & Høstsabbat festival comes together for the honorable celebration of Tony Iommi (Black Sabbath) first solo record in 21 years! The night will feature a full listening session for the highly anticipated "From The Dark" one day prior to the official release to the masses. The record will of course be played on our live room PA-system for that extra sonic extravanganza!
Lottery
Grab a ticket at the door and join the lottery, free of charge, for a chance to win official Iommi merch provided by the label. Rumour has it there will be black gold and other quality items available so you definitely don't want to miss out on this one.
DJs
Høstsabbat DJs will set the tone before and after the listening session, and attendees will get early access to this years official festival merch.
Ticket exchange
Trade your Høstsabbat-tickets for wristbands to get you good and ready for the next couple of days in the church of riffness!
On top of all that - as always at Vaterland - plenty of lesk, Satan-pizza and massive vibes!
Times
17:00 Event start: Høstsabbat DJs + Ticket exchange & Merch
19:00 "From The Dark" listening session
19:50 Lottery: winners pull
20:00 Høstsabbat DJs
And don't worry, all times set up to match the Høstsabbat Live-Event at our lovely neighbours Brewgata on the same night.
Yeh, and best of all, ITS totally FREE!
So... lets gather in masses, just like witches
